  • Verified that patched binary is not affected, by way of both PoCs on https://debbugs.gnu.org/cgi/bugreport.cgi?bug=82213#5
  • Also, applied https://github.com/emacsmirror/emacs/commit/5bf385dad6e5a2c2a9584252b99484cdbfeae66b.patch, to fix regression described here: https://lists.gnu.org/archive/html/emacs-devel/2026-11/msg00353.html
